text:
Maya: Random question — if Redwood could invent one company holiday (official day off + celebrations), what would it be called and how would we celebrate? 🎉

Alex: "Latency Day" — mandatory 2pm power nap, pizza at lunch, and a 'fastest deploy' (toy trophy) contest. :sleeping: :pizza: :trophy:

Sam: "Quantize-athon" — a weekend hackathon but low-precision only. Snacks + weird model mascots. Winner gets a giant foam 8-bit TPU. :robot_face:

Taylor: "Bring Your Pet Model" — everyone posts a pic of a pet or a dad-joke model, parade in #random, tiny prizes for funniest output. I'll add a GIF. https://giphy.com/gifs/funny-dog-3oriO0OEd9QIDdllqo

Rachel: "No-Table-Meetings Day" — all async updates, no meetings >15m, extra focus time, and a community yoga class at 3pm. :raised_hands: :lotus_position:

Jen: Big vote for "Ship Early, Nap Often" day — 4-hour work day, board games in the lounge, cereal bar. Honestly would increase morale 100%. :cereal: :game_die:

Ethan: I like "Latency Day" but renamed "Latency & Lattes": coffee cart + comfy chairs + code katas. :coffee:

Maya: Love these. Quick poll — react with :one: for Ship Early Nap Often, :two: for Latency Day, :three: for Quantize-athon, :four: for Bring Your Pet Model, :five: for No-Meeting Day.

Alex: :one: :thumbsup:

Sam: :three:

Taylor: :four: :heart_eyes:

Rachel: :five:

Jen: :one: :clap:

RedwoodBot: Poll recorded — 6 reactions so far. Use `/holiday-suggest` to add more ideas.

Maya: Thanks all — leaving this open. Maybe we'll pitch the top idea to People Ops next week. :sparkles:
